mechanism_narrative: A rising GDPC1 indicates increased economic activity, which should positively impact S&P 500 returns as corporate earnings are expected to improve.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative over the 20-day horizon in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in UNRATE above 10% signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns as economic growth may slow.
failure_condition: UNRATE exceeds 10% but S&P 500 returns remain positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS is low and UNRATE is high, it indicates a potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: The specified conditions are met but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Growth in INDPRO during an economic expansion signals increased production, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative over the 60-day horizon in more than 30% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Low FEDFUNDS rates encourage borrowing and investment, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains low but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in HOUST indicates stronger housing demand, which can lead to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: HOUST exceeds 600 but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High RSAFS indicates strong consumer spending, which, combined with low FEDFUNDS, boosts economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 returns.
regime_hint: low interest rate environment with strong consumer demand
failure_condition: The specified conditions are met but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A low UNRATE during economic expansion indicates a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: UNRATE remains below 9% but S&P 500 returns are negative over the 60-day horizon in more than 30% of cases.
